payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over all positions in s and t with a 2D DP table; dp[i+1][j+1] accumulates counts of substring-subsequence matches using prefix sum along t.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a 2D array dp[i+1][j+1] where i indexes s and j indexes t, typical of dp_2d_state. The recurrence involves dp[i+1][j] and dp[i][j], handling substring-subsequence matching.
